programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Daryl Palumbo of Glassjaw and Head Automatica. Daryl reflects on three decades of genre-defying music, the freedom he’s always pursued as an artist, the self-doubt and restlessness that shaped his work, and how fatherhood became the most grounding and fulfilling experience of his life.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy-nominated drummer Aric Improta joins Joel Madden to talk about the sacredness of creativity, the balance between chaos and discipline, and the art of manifestation. They reflect on Improta’s upbringing in a family of artists, his work with Fever 333 and Night Verses, and the philosophy behind sustaining inspiration while navigating the demands of modern music.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: O'Shea Jackson Jr. on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Actor and writer O’Shea Jackson Jr. joins Joel Madden for an insightful conversation about Hollywood’s misconceptions, family legacy, and creative purpose. Jackson discusses balancing fame with authenticity, lessons from his upbringing, the importance of privacy in the digital age, and how writing became a core outlet for his creativity.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Drag superstar, musician, and TV personality Trixie Mattel joins Joel Madden for a candid conversation about growing up in small-town Wisconsin, discovering drag, and building a multifaceted career in music, television, and business. They discuss identity, faith, creativity, and the crossover between drag and punk culture — finding connection through authenticity and humor.

programme.title: Korn: Live
programme.desc: Korn performs a hit-filled live set at Hammerstein Ballroom, featuring songs like Freak on a Leash and Here to Stay.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.sub-title: Joshua Roberts (Magnolia Park) on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Magnolia Park frontman Joshua Roberts joins Joel Madden for a heartfelt conversation about anime, identity, and carving out space in rock music. Joshua reflects on navigating racism in the scene, channeling emotion into art, and leading Magnolia Park’s creative community with resilience and purpose. From social media strategy to self-belief, this episode dives deep into what it means to stay authentic while inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Dan + Shay. Dan + Shay met at a house party in Nashville in December 2012 and started writing songs together not long after — an unlikely pairing, given Dan came from an emo band background and Shay had been a solo artist on T-Pain's label. Since then, the duo has become one of the most decorated acts in country music history: three consecutive Grammy Awards for Best Country Duo/Group Performance for "Tequila," "Speechless," and "10,000 Hours" with Justin Bieber, alongside dozens of ACM, CMA, and Billboard Music Award wins. Their crossover success has made them global streaming juggernauts, and in 2024 they became the first-ever coaching duo in the history of NBC's The Voice. Sitting down with Joel, Dan + Shay open up about the highs of over a decade together — the awards, the arenas, the recognition — but also the harder work underneath it: learning to communicate honestly, untangling their self-worth from their results, and figuring out what it actually means to build a lasting partnership, both as a band and as best friends.

programme.title: Porno for Pyros: Horns, Thorns En Halos Farewell Tour Live from Los Angeles
programme.desc: Porno for Pyros take the stage one final time for their Horns, Thorns En Halos Farewell Tour, performing live from The Belasco Theater in Los Angeles. Frontman Perry Farrell, guitarist Peter DiStefano, drummer Stephen Perkins, and bassist Martyn LeNoble deliver an electrifying and emotional performance that spans their entire career — from hits like Pets and Tahitian Moon to deep cuts and spoken interludes that showcase their surreal, art-rock energy. Captured exclusively on Veeps, this farewell show celebrates three decades of psychedelic alternative rock and the enduring chemistry that defined the band’s sound.

programme.desc: Belgian conductor Jos van Immerseel leads Anima Eterna Brugge.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.sub-title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: In celebration of the pieces' 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony - A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with a concert program; under the baton of Christian Schumann, the bands team up and perform from "Lord of the Rings," "The Witcher," "League of Legends" and more.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.sub-title: Franz in Vienna: Mozart and Schoenberg
programme.desc: Austrian conductor Franz Welser-Möst leads the Cleveland Orchestra in a performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Divertimento No. 2 in D major, KV 131, and Arnold Schoenberg’s Variations for Orchestra, Op. 31.

programme.title: Mozart -- Quintet for Piano and Winds, K. 452
programme.sub-title: Mozart -- Quintet for Piano and Winds, K. 452
programme.desc: Luca Vignali (oboe), Angelo De Angelis (clarinet), Carmine Pinto (horn), Eliseo Smordoni (bassoon), and Linda Di Carlo (piano) perform Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Quintet for piano and winds in E-flat major, K. 452.

programme.title: Mahler Song Cycles: Songs on the Death of Children
programme.sub-title: Mahler Song Cycles: Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.sub-title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians.

programme.title: Beethoven: Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.sub-title: Beethoven: Symphonies and Piano Concerto No. 4
programme.desc: Opening with the composer's Symphony No. 1 in C major, Op. 21; Fischer conducts Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 4 in G major, Op. 58, in which Richard Goode features as the soloist.

programme.title: Mozart, Symphony No. 41, K. 551
programme.desc: Jeffrey Tate conducts the English Chamber Orchestra in a performance of Mozart's Jupiter Symphony No. 41; the symphony is the last of a set of three that Mozart composed in rapid succession during the summer of 1788.

programme.title: Walton: Viola Concerto & Brahms: Symphony No. 4
programme.sub-title: Walton: Viola Concerto & Brahms: Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance of Brahms's Symphony No. Four; Antoine Tamestit continues his Artist Portrait.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: The symphony's immense emotional scope, features innovative use of large-scale forces for breathtaking sound, and an ambitious philosophical journey that connects listeners to the grandeur of the natural world.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 & Elgar's Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.

programme.title: Sibelius, Mendelssohn & Saariaho
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress leads the LSO in a Northern European concert from LSO St Luke's, featuring works by Sibelius, Mendelssohn and Kaija Saariaho; the evening includes Sibelius's En Saga and Cassazione, Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es cierto: lo bueno en exceso puede ser malo. Cuando se produce un accidente que afecta a la fórmula mágica de Papá Pitufo y este acaba duplicado, los Pitufos se muestran encantados: dos Papás Pitufo pueden dar el doble de buenos consejos y el doble de amor que uno solo. Sin embargo, después de un tiempo, las cosas se complican en exceso en la aldea. ¡Sobre todo cuando otro accidente hace que Gargamel también se duplique!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel ha echado tantas sustancias tóxicas en su estanque que el agua se vuelve encantada. Tras caerse en el estanque, Gargamel se vuelve pequeño, tan pequeño que Papá Pitufo tendrá que salvarlo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un duende maligno le pone unos zapatos mágicos a Pitufina, que no puede dejar de bailar, con la intención de que le prometa que se casará con él. Todos sus pequeños amigos acuden a rescatarla y Papá Pitufo consigue ponerle los zapatos mágicos al duende, obligándole a bailar hasta que se hace de noche.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la caja que ha encontrado Pitufo Bromista? Una capa que perteneció a Wislow, el gnomo mago. ¿Y de qué tipo de capa se trata? Pitufo Bromista descubre que es una capa de invisibilidad. Cualquiera que la lleve puesta tendrá una oportunidad fantástica para hacer bromas… e imagina el caos que puede crear Pitufo Bromista siendo invisible en la aldea. Pero si Wislow se desprendió de la capa, seguro que tenía sus motivos…

programme.title: El Pitufo Reportero
programme.desc: Pitufo Curioso ha tenido una idea: ¿por qué no imprimir un boletín con todas las noticias de la aldea? Está seguro de que sus cotilleos sobre los Pitufos interesarán a todos los lectores. Pero las cosas no salen exactamente según lo previsto cuando Papá Pitufo encuentra superpitufrutas.

programme.title: El Amo Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador es el reticente amo de un genio llamado Gourdy, cuyo entusiasmo por ser servicial es quizá algo excesivo. Tras un nuevo incidente provocado por el exceso de celo de Gourdy, Pitufo Labrador le dice algo que no debería haber dicho y Gourdy desaparece. ¿Y a que no adivinas quién lo encuentra? En efecto: Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. ¿Y quién podría arrebatar a Gourdy de las manos de Escrupuloso, sino el propio Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las preocupaciones de Papá Pitufo hacen que le salgan verrugas. La única forma de librarle de esta enfermedad causada por la indecisión es que frote el cuerno de uno de los Verrugosos, los desaliñados, viscosos, estúpidos y brutales enemigos de las haditas del Bosque de los Sauces…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Celoso por la atención que recibe Pitufo Vanidoso cuando se rompe un dedo del pie, Pitufo Bromista finge estar enfermo con la esperanza de que le hagan caso. Desafortunadamente, su treta se vuelve en su contra y, en lugar de amorosos cuidados, todo lo que recibe es un proverbial merecido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Miedoso entra corriendo en la aldea y grita que el cielo se está cayendo. Justo en ese mismo momento, Papá Pitufo está aquejado de un incontrolable ataque de estornudos…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos hambrientos descubren una cueva en donde se encuentra oculta comida congelada custodiada por un trol también congelado quien fue encarcelado debido a su avaricia por un diamante mágico. Mientras los Pitufos descongelan la cueva Gargamel roba la comida, pero el diamante mágico lo transforma en una masa helada y el trol liberado ayuda gustosamente a los Pitufos a cargar la comida de regreso a su aldea.

programme.title: El Dulce Diente De Pitufina
programme.desc: Una vez al año, Pitufo Goloso prepara un lote especial de caramelos de pitufrutas. Cada Pitufo recibe provisiones para un año entero del dulce más pitufantástico de todo el mundo. Pero ¿puede un Pitufo conseguir que sus provisiones le duren todo el año? ¿Lo conseguirá Pitufina?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado hechicero Gargamel acude una vez más a Esmeralda, la adivinadora, la cual se las ingenia para hacerse con el dinero de Gargamel. Cuando es el turno de los Pitufos, les hace creer que existe un árbol de la suerte…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Habia Una Vez Una Luna Azul
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban cogiéndole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve a por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que la acaban devolviéndoles el bebé.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos llevan a Abuelo Pitufo al castillo del rey para que pueda conocer a Guillermo. Pero, entre una cosa y otra (sobre todo otra), los Pitufos y Guillermo acaban a bordo de una gran nave vikinga. Los vikingos creen que Guillermo es su mítico gran guerrero, aquel que derrotará al Rey Tormenta. ¿Podrán los Pitufos ayudar a Guillermo a salir de este embrollo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un hechizo ha alterado las cajas sorpresa explosivas de Pitufo Bromista. Imagina la cara de desconcierto que se le queda a este guasón cuando se da cuenta de que todas las sorpresas que entrega a otros incautos Pitufos en realidad contienen regalos. ¡Se acabaron las explosiones, las bromas y la diversión! Y a eso se le une su poco envidiable posición como el Pitufo más popular de la aldea, rodeado de admiradores que no cesan de pedirle más obsequios…

programme.title: La Novia De Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Brenda, la pequeña bruja, se siente rechazada: nadie la quiere llevar al Baile de las Escobas de este año. Ay, si pudiera encontrar a algún chico guapo… Entonces conoce a Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. Es muy apuesto, ¡y está libre! Lo que ella no sabe es que Escrupuloso solamente está interesado en su varita mágica. Y lo que saben los Pitufos es que la van a ayudar a salir del aprieto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Tontín, al querer ser el más popular, roba uno de los hechizos de Gargamel, pero no lo usa bien y acaba convirtiéndose en un dragón. Ahora tendrán que juntarse todos los Pitufos junto con Papá Pitufo para colarse en el castillo de Gargamel y encontrar el antídoto que hará que Pitufo Tontín vuelva a su forma normal.

programme.title: El Dia Libre De Papá Pitufo
programme.desc: Los Pitufos deciden que Papá Pitufo necesita un descanso, por lo que acuerdan resolver sus problemas sin su ayuda. Papá Pitufo se siente inútil, pero Ómnibus, su sabio amigo, le muestra que los Pitufos no podrían arreglárselas sin él. Papá Pitufo regresa justo a tiempo para arreglar una presa que tiene fugas, y se siente útil de nuevo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha salvado a Pitufo Torpe de un terrible destino. Pitufo Torpe jura devoción eterna a su salvador y se esfuerza al máximo por saldar su deuda… con consecuencias desastrosas. Se hace necesario idear un plan ingenioso para evitar las bienintencionadas catástrofes causadas por Pitufo Torpe…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogatha se disfraza de premio de oro para observar a los Pitufos y capturarlos para sus ingredientes de belleza. Vanidoso acaba convenciéndola de que pruebe su receta y acaba cubierta de barro de vuelta a casa de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Te despiertas temprano por la mañana, antes de que los demás Pitufos se hayan levantado de sus camas, para preparar sabrosos bizcochos de pitufrutas. Dedicas toda la mañana a preparar pitufimanjares para el almuerzo. Después, toda la tarde a tener la deliciosa cena lista a tiempo. ¿Y acaso los demás Pitufos te dan siquiera las gracias? Así pues, Pitufo Goloso renuncia. La aldea está en problemas… y pronto, también lo está Pitufo Goloso.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo organiza un grupo para navegar a una lejana isla ya que Gargamel ha cortado todos los árboles menos uno para atrapar a los pitufos. Gargamel les sigue pero la Bruja de la isla acaba enviando sus gaviotas tras él.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La malvada bruja se transforma en Pitufo para vengarse de ellos por destruir su amuleto mágico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Bebé Pitufo ha perdido el interés por los juguetes. Ni siquiera las sorpresas de Pitufo Bromista consiguen entretener al pequeño. Abuelo Pitufo propone hacer una visita al Juguetero, el encargado de fabricar juguetes para los niños de todo el mundo. O más bien, el que los fabricaba: el Juguetero está cansado del poco aprecio que demuestran por sus juguetes aquellos que los reciben.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel vuelve a estar en problemas. Si no puede reunir una enorme cantidad de oro para el atardecer, le arrebatarán todas sus posesiones. Sin embargo, los Pitufos van a ayudar a su archienemigo… hasta cierto punto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un extraño diablillo, que es todo un maestro de los juegos, desafía a los Pitufos en una competición. Transforma a los Pitufitos en rígidas piezas de ajedrez y obliga a Pitufo Gruñón, que nunca gana a ningún juego, a jugar para salvar las vidas de los Pitufitos. Pitufo Gruñón va sintiéndose más seguro, realiza el movimiento correcto y consigue liberar a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Nadie le cree al Abuelo Pitufo cuando habla de junglas y sabanas lejanas, repletas de gatos salvajes gigantes, caballos a rayas, comedores de hojas de cuello largo y extrañas tribus… Tan solo algunos Pitufitos dan cierto crédito a sus historias. Pero, cuando Abuelo Pitufo escucha en el bosque el sonido del tambor real mágico, un instrumento capaz de domar bestias salvajes, se lanza a la aventura para demostrar que no es un contador de historias al que el cerebro le juega malas pasadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio ha decidido dedicarse al bienestar de los demás Pitufos. Va a curarles de todos sus males…con la ayuda del malvado Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Fortachón descubre a un caballero que lo ayuda a combatir a un Dragón, pero éste huye y deja a Fortachón defendiendo a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La repulsiva bruja Hogata captura a Pitufina. Quiere robarle a la pequeña belleza azul su cabello dorado. ¿Conseguirán salvar los Pitufos a su pequeña compañera antes de que sea demasiado tarde? ¿Logrará Hogata una cabellera como la de Pitufina?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Goloso Y La Olla De Estofado
programme.desc: El hada buena Guinilda entrega a Pitufo Goloso una olla mágica, pero Pitufo Filósofo hace que se desborde e inunde la aldea y el bosque. La bienintencionada hada acude al rescate y pide que le devuelvan la olla para dársela a un orfanato de niños hambrientos.

programme.title: El Concurso De Mr. Pitufo
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo decide celebrar una fiesta de la cosecha, y todos los Pitufos compiten en el concurso de «Mr. Pitufo» por el honor de ser el acompañante de Sasita. Gargamel se cuela en el concurso después de encoger su cuerpo con un tinte azul mágico, con la esperanza de capturar a todos los Pitufos cuando vuelva a su tamaño normal. Los Pitufos le echan y Sasita decide que Papá Pitufo será su acompañante.

programme.title: La Abominable Bestia De La Nieve
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y sus amigos organizan una jornada en la Montaña de Hielo para buscar la rara flor de la nieve para Papá Pitufo. Encuentran una terrorífica bestia de la nieve, pero acaban siendo amigos gracias a la amabilidad de Pitufina, y les ayuda a encontrar la minúscula flor.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo lo ha vuelto a hacer. Además, esta vez ha sido delante de Papá Pitufo. Ha pronunciado un hechizo que convierte todo en piedra. Todo, incluyendo a él mismo y a los demás Pitufos, así como la aldea y muchos kilómetros del bosque que hay alrededor. Afortunadamente, aparece Guillermo.

programme.title: La Novia De Escrúpulo
programme.desc: Brenda, la pequeña bruja, se siente rechazada: nadie la quiere llevar al Baile de las Escobas de este año. Ay, si pudiera encontrar a algún chico guapo… Entonces conoce a Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. Es muy apuesto, ¡y está libre! Lo que ella no sabe es que Escrupuloso solamente está interesado en su varita mágica. Y lo que saben los Pitufos es que la van a ayudar a salir del aprieto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo y Bebé Pitufo mezclan las fórmulas de Papá Pitufo con consecuencias desastrosas, dejándoles a merced de un ejército de hambrientas langostas que Gargamel ha soltado en el bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Una malvada hechicera lanza un hechizo a los Pitufos, obligándoles a amarse a sí mismos en lugar de amar a los demás. Pitufo Vanidoso, que siempre ha actuado así, estaba lejos en ese momento, pero nota el cambio a su regreso. Rompe el hechizo haciendo que todos los Pitufos coman un pastel de humildad cocinado por un mago.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay algún tipo de poder maligno en la corona del Titan que Minero encuentra bajo tierra, y Avaricioso acaba sucumbiendo a él. Cuando Gargamel aparece con una de sus fechorías en mente, todo se acaba enrevesándose.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aprenden que la mente es más fuerte que la materia gracias a un engañoso y caro tónico milagroso de un charlatán. Pero Papá Pitufo les hará ver que no es más que un charlatán.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se preparan para recuperar una concha marina que necesitan para liberar a un ermitaño de las garras de la Bruja del Mar, la cual la maldijo con un aspecto horrible y un lenguaje difícil de entender. Los Pitufos consiguen recuperar la concha a tiempo para romper el maleficio y devolver al ermitaño a su verdadero ser.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Papá Pitufo le da a Pitufo Debilucho una crema especial para que la utilice y recupere su fuerza. Poco después, recibe una condecoración por sus heroicos actos de fortaleza, y su autoestima se dispara cuando se da cuenta de que la crema es simplemente mermelada de pitufrutas.

programme.title: Los Visitantes
programme.desc: ¿Qué es esa pequeña luna que ha llegado del cielo? Es un globo de barro cubierto de cráteres y habitado por los Lodosos, una familia de criaturas que vienen del cielo y comen y salpican barro. No todos los Pitufos demuestran entusiasmo por los visitantes…

programme.title: ¡alarma, Pitufos!
programme.desc: Los Pitufitos se sienten poco queridos y deciden huir. Se llevan consigo objetos que les recuerden su hogar, lo que hace que los Pitufos crean que hay un ladrón entre ellos. Pitufo Filósofo intenta atrapar al ladrón instalando pitufialarmas. Las alarmas provocan un estruendo que atrae a los Pitufitos de vuelta a casa, donde Papá Pitufo les convence de que los quieren.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Enfermizo se convierte en un héroe cuando se olvida de sus dolencias y salva al resto de los Pitufos de las peligrosas flores del olvido.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Viaje Al Pitufo De La Tierra
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado a la Aldea Pitufa. Y los pequeños Pitufos están helados de frío. ¿Pero qué está haciendo Pitufo Torpe con esa extraña roca que ha descubierto? ¿Y por qué está tan entusiasmado Pitufo Minero con su nuevo descubrimiento? Nadie entiende a qué se debe tanto revuelo por una simple nueva roca para la colección de Pitufo Torpe… Al adentrarse bajo tierra, los Pitufos encontrarán peligros y sorpresas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las pinturas del malvado Maestro son capaces de tele portar a sus modelos dentro del cuadro…para siempre! Papá pitufo le dice a Pintor que cambie las pinturas y en poco tiempo Maestro acaba dentro de uno de sus cuadros, al lado de su modelo de ensueño: Pitufina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que No Podia Decir No
programme.desc: Pitufo Palomo no puede decir que no y eso provoca que todos le encarguen sus tareas. Pronto eso lo llevará a enfrentar un gran peligro.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusión de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolás para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papá Pitufo y los demás pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: El Pitufo Que Queria Ser Rey
programme.desc: Pitufo Soñador anhela convertirse en rey después de leer una historia sobre reyes. Mientras está en su barco, cae a través de un remolino y llega a una tierra de pequeños seres que creen que Pitufo Soñador es su rey, desaparecido hace mucho tiempo. Cuando se enfrenta a los Norfnangs, los enemigos de esos pequeños seres, descubre que no son terroríficos en absoluto. Pitufo Soñador se da un golpe en la cabeza y descubre al despertar que todo había sido un sueño, aunque encuentra en su gorro una joya idéntica a las que extraían esos pequeños seres de su mina.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha tenido una nueva y revolucionaria idea: una especie de carro que se mueve sobre raíles y no requiere que los Pitufos tiren de él. Lo llama pitufitren y hace que la vida en la aldea resulte menos cansada… hasta que Gargamel lo descubre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufitos acompañan a Pitufo Lanudo en su misión de esquilar ovejas para obtener lana para la ropa de invierno. Deben superar varios obstáculos, como Gargamel, un lobo y, por último, un pastorcillo que no acepta pitufrutas como pago por la lana. El respeto mutuo entre los Pitufitos y Pitufo Lanudo va creciendo a lo largo del viaje.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogata consigue los pendientes dorados mágicos de Sonoria, que le permitirán oír las voces de los Pitufos desde lejos. Siguiendo los ronquidos de Pitufo Perezoso, está a punto de llegar hasta la Aldea Pitufa, pero entonces los sonidos del cuerno de Pitufo Armonía comienzan a resonar en sus pendientes y huye enfurecida de vuelta a casa.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos llevan a Abuelo Pitufo al castillo del rey para que pueda conocer a Guillermo. Pero, entre una cosa y otra (sobre todo otra), los Pitufos y Guillermo acaban a bordo de una gran nave vikinga. Los vikingos creen que Guillermo es su mítico gran guerrero, aquel que derrotará al Rey Tormenta. ¿Podrán los Pitufos ayudar a Guillermo a salir de este embrollo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio ha decidido dedicarse al bienestar de los demás Pitufos. Va a curarles de todos sus males…con la ayuda del malvado Gargamel!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La nota que Papá Pitufo escribió avisando a los demás Pitufos para que vean un cometa está rota. Al ser sólo capaces de leer una parte, los Pitufos creen que es el fin del mundo. Todos planean cómo será su último día, hasta que papá Pitufo regresa y clarifica el lío.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Genio inventa una máquina que hará todo el trabajo de cosechar y preparar la comido de los Pitufos. Pero esta milagrosa invención tiene sus bemoles.

programme.title: El Pitufo Enmascarado
programme.desc: Una noche de Luna Azulada, tal y como la leyenda decía, un bebé pitufo aparece en el pueblo, y todos acaban agarrándole cariño. Pero todo ha sido un malentendido y la cigüeña vuelve por el bebé. Pintor y Gruñón se han encariñado tanto con el bebé que les regresan al bebé.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Gruñón aprende que las emociones pueden ser fantásticas, sobre todo después de que la malvada Clorhidris cree un corazón de hielo para despojar a todos de la bondad y el amor.

programme.title: ¿Cómo Hacer Un Arcoíris?
programme.desc: La madre naturaleza está demasiado ocupada para evocar un Arcoíris para el Festival de los Pitufos, así que Papá Pitufo pide prestado su libro de cocina para realizar la mezcla él mismo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo lo ha vuelto a hacer. Además, esta vez ha sido delante de Papá Pitufo. Ha pronunciado un hechizo que convierte todo en piedra. Todo, incluyendo a él mismo y a los demás Pitufos, así como la aldea y muchos kilómetros del bosque que hay alrededor. Afortunadamente, aparece Guillermo.

programme.title: Símbolos De Sabiduría
programme.desc: Pitufo Filósofo está desesperado por parecerse más a Papá Pitufo. ¿Podría ser la respuesta un tónico capilar? ¿Conseguirá Gargamel capturar por fin a los Pitufos? ¿Reside realmente la sabiduría en una barba?

programme.title: Pitufo Sabelotodo
programme.desc: Nadie escucha nunca los consejos de Pitufo Filósofo, así que, cuando Papá Pitufo se va de viaje y Pitufo Filósofo cree estar al mando, decide que va a ser el que tenga todas las respuestas. El libro de hechizos de Papá Pitufo contiene una fórmula mágica para garantizar que todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa acudan a Pitufo Filósofo para pedirle su opinión. Y, por si las cosas no fueran lo suficientemente complicadas, aquí llega Gargamel…

programme.title: El Genio De Granjero
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta qué hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando debería estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hará que, más que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El chico del bosque y Laconia, la elfa muda y sorda, preguntan a Papá Pitufo que celebre su boda. Mientras los Pitufos preparan la fiesta bajo las órdenes de Pitufina, Gargamel hace acto de presencia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué es esa extraña rana parlante que ha hecho que el hechicero Morlock haya enviado a todos los soldados del príncipe Teodoro para capturarla? ¿Es una rana demonio, como él dice? ¿O quizá lo hace por otro motivo? La verdad se desvelará cuando Pitufina y los Pitufitos se encuentran con la rana. Ayudan a la rana a volver a transformarse en el príncipe Teodoro, que había sido víctima de un hechizo lanzado por Morlock.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro mágico de Papá Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Genio inventa una máquina que hará todo el trabajo de cosechar y preparar la comido de los Pitufos. Pero esta milagrosa invención tiene sus bemoles.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Día de los Inocentes Pitufo resulta no ser tan divertido cuando Gargamel se pone un disfraz de Pitufoarbusto para capturar al pequeño Pitufo Feliz. Papá Pitufo pide ayuda a Pitufopluma para que llame a los pájaros y ataquen al falso arbusto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Colérico pierde a su oso de peluche Huggy, no consigue dormir a pesar de los esfuerzos de Papá Pitufo por convencerle de que los osos de peluche son mágicos y pueden cuidar de sí mismos. Gargamel se tropieza con la Aldea Pitufa y Huggy regresa convertido en un oso gigante para espantarle y salvar a Pitufo Colérico.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La bruja Hogata promete a Gargamel un silbato mágico si este le presenta al brujo de sus sueños. Sin embargo, ambos se engañan mutuamente con sus triquiñuelas: Gargamel se disfraza de brujo, y el silbato mágico de Hogata es simplemente un reclamo para aves.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Las preocupaciones de Papá Pitufo hacen que le salgan verrugas. La única forma de librarle de esta enfermedad causada por la indecisión es que frote el cuerno de uno de los Verrugosos, los desaliñados, viscosos, estúpidos y brutales enemigos de las haditas del Bosque de los Sauces…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Mientras los pitufos construyen cápsulas del tiempo para guardar sus talentos, Papá Pitufo está tratando desesperadamente de acertar un acertijo druídico antes de que un gran desastre llegue al bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufina guía a los Pitufos de caminata por la naturaleza, pero Puppy se adelantó demasiado y tras perseguirlo acaban en el territorio de los Wartmongers. El Rey de los Wartmongers acaba haciéndoles prisioneros en burbujas, pero un grupo de rebeldes les rescata y consiguen huir a lomos de Puppy.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Palabra De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: Los Pitufitos liberan a los Pitufos de las garras de Gargamel justo a tiempo para llevar a Bebé Pitufo a la ceremonia de su primera palabra. Bebé Pitufo pronuncia la palabra «Gargamel». Papá Pitufo afirma que esa palabra indica que Bebé Pitufo se convertirá un día en un gran líder, ya que significa que es consciente de los peligros de la vida.

programme.title: Cuidando A Pies Grandes
programme.desc: ¿Recuerdas al ogro Gigantón y a su encantadora esposa Narizota? Ahora tienen un bebé: el pequeño (según los estándares de los ogros) Pies Grandes. Como a los Pitufitos no les permiten cuidar de Bebé Pitufo, Pitufo Colérico, Pitufo Blandengue, Pitufo Natural y la siempre dispuesta Sasita se ofrecen a vigilar a Pies Grandes mientras sus padres están en el baile de los ogros. Los Pitufitos conseguirán más de lo que esperaban…

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel infecta de odio el corazón de Pitufo Fortachón y, a continuación, usa al pequeño Pitufo como señuelo para los demás. Afortunadamente, el amor de Pitufo Fortachón vence al odio y ayuda a sus pequeños amigos a escapar de las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La repulsiva bruja Hogata captura a Pitufina. Quiere robarle a la pequeña belleza azul su cabello dorado. ¿Conseguirán salvar los Pitufos a su pequeña compañera antes de que sea demasiado tarde? ¿Logrará Hogata una cabellera como la de Pitufina?

programme.title: Pitufos Helados
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado y los Pitufos están a punto de sucumbir al intenso frío. ¿Podrá Pitufo Rastreador encontrar el remedio sin caer en las garras de Gargamel?

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Shimmer, Shine and Leah explore the Dragon Forest and meet Farnaz, a Dragon Rider who teaches them to ride dragons! But when Zeta takes a flock of dragons, including Farnaz's, the girls and Farnaz must work together to stop her before it's too late.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When the girls bake a cake with bouncing flour, it bounces off and they must catch it in time for Roya's Feather Day party! A potion spill turns Rocket's barks magical. But when the magic gets out of control, the kids must find a way to stop it.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: A stinky bug infestation in Zeta's secret lair forces her to spend the night at Shimmer and Shine's Palace. Zeta and Nazboo have to take care of Shimmer, Shine, and Leah when a potion mishap turns them into little babies.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Zeta uses a Zahracorn suit to sneak her, Nazboo, and his family into the Zahracorn Parade, but the disguise goes haywire! Zeta grows jealous when Nazboo gets an enchanted robe that allows him to do magic.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When Zeta's sister comes to visit, Zeta is shocked to discover that her once sorcerific sister is now a genie! When Samira sends the girls out on a fun quest, Zeta tricks them into finding a bunch of magical items for her instead.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: An enchanted treasure map leads Shimmer, Shine, Leah, and their Dragon Rider friend Farnaz to the powerful Dragon Gem. But when Zeta gets ahold of the gem, it's up to Farnaz and the girls to get it back before Zeta becomes too powerful to stop.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When a potion brings Nazboo's squeaky chicken to life, Zeta tries to use the tricky toy to help her take over Zahramay Falls. Shimmer, Shine, and Leah must help Adara when Zeta uses a potion to control the Princess's bracelets from afar.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Nazboo goes off to help a genie with his deliveries, but Zeta worries she's lost him and enlists the girls' help to find him. When the girls learn to cloud surf, Shine gets overexcited and tries to ride the biggest wave at Cloud Beach.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Shimmer, Shine and Leah go to a new place called Zahramay Oceanea to help train a young genie-in-training named Arabella. But when Zeta shows up and tries to take over Oceanea, it's up to the girls and their new friend to stop her.

programme.title: Rings

programme.title: Quarantine

programme.title: Juwanna Mann
programme.desc: A basketball star is booted out of the NBA when his on-court antics go too far, so he poses as a woman and joins the WUBA. Rated PG-13

programme.title: The Nutty Professor (1996)
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy gives "the performances" of his career -- playing seven roles! -- in this hilarious comedy about a genetics professor who experiments with his own fat-reducing serum.

programme.title: Avengement
programme.desc: While released on furlough from prison, a lowly criminal evades his guards and returns to his old haunts to take revenge on the people that made him a cold-hearted killer.

programme.title: Lights Out
programme.desc: A drifting ex-soldier turns underground fighter with the help of a just-released ex-con, pitting them both against corrupt cops and hired killers gunning for them and all those they care about.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: The all-star cast returns to pull serious spoofs of The Grudge, Saw, War of the Worlds, and The Village. While her house is haunted by a little boy, Cindy is determined to find out who killed him and why.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Home with their newly-formed family, happy parents Dan and Jody are haunted by sinister, paranormal activities — disrupting new mama Jody’s dancing aspirations in the “Swan Lake” ballet and threatening Dan’s rise as an ape researcher.

programme.title: Ella Enchanted
programme.desc: Oscar-winner Anne Hathaway stars in an unforgettable, modern fairy tale in which a girl's given the gift of obedience by her Fairy Godmother. An amazing, magical adventure bursting with colorful characters, music, wit, and whimsy.

programme.title: What's Love Got to Do With It?
programme.desc: In London, an award-winning filmmaker documents her best friend's journey into an arranged marriage in line with his family's Pakistani heritage. In the process, she challenges her own attitude towards relationships.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: When the brilliant but unorthodox scientist Dr. Victor Frankenstein rejects the artificial man that he has created, the Creature escapes and later swears revenge.

programme.title: School Ties
programme.desc: After receiving a scholarship to an exclusive prep school, working-class teen David Greene becomes a star athlete and wins the attention of a beautiful debutante.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Fun Size
programme.desc: Wren is a hip girl whose plans to attend the high school event of the year ends when she has to babysit her brother. When he disappears, Wren must set out to find him before her mom discovers he's missing.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: After a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, 19-year-old Jay becomes trapped by a vicious curse - "it" is following her, and the only way to save herself is to put others in harm's way.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Paranormal Activity: The Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: For the first time, you will SEE the activity... When a new family moves into a familiar house, they discover a mysterious video camera that reveals a demonic threat and soon find themselves terrorized by an ancient evil.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: Art The Clown sets his sights on three young women, along with anyone else that gets in his way.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
programme.desc: This time, he seems to have set his sights on the young patients at a secluded halfway house. And more than a few of his teen targets end up in half, in quarters... You name it, Jason does it.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Lucky Number Slevin
programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity lands Slevin into the middle of a war being plotted by two of the city's most rival crime bosses: The Rabbi and The Boss.

programme.title: Road to Perdition
programme.desc: Bonds of loyalty are put to the test when a hitman's son witnesses what his father does for a living.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: Idle Hands
programme.desc: The devil will find work for idle hands to do, but what happens when he chooses the laziest teen slacker in the world to do his dirty work? Anton Tobias is a couch potato burnout who can't control the murderous impulses of his possessed hand. Rated: R

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: A group of small-town high school students discovers their teachers are under the control of mind-controlling alien parasites. From a smart script by Kevin Williamson (SCREAM), and directed by action-expert Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Harold and Maude
programme.desc: A classic cult film that features one of the screen's most unlikely pairs. It will defy everything you've ever seen or known about screen lovers.

programme.title: The Crow: Wicked Prayer
programme.desc: The fourth film in the dark superhero franchise is an epic new action tale. After an ex-con tries to straighten out his life, he and his girlfriend are brutally murdered by a renegade gang. A mysterious crow brings him back for revenge and redemption.

programme.title: Hellboy
programme.desc: After years of hiding from a society that shuns him, Hellboy and his team attempt to stop the resurrection of an ancient witch who once spread an unstoppable plague before she was locked away by the legendary King Arthur.

programme.title: Little Nicky
programme.desc: When Satan reneges on his plans to retire, two of his three heirs leave Hell to gather enough souls to vote the Prince of Darkness out of office. But Satan sends his youngest—and nicest—son, Little Nicky, to bring the other two home.

programme.title: Mr. Deeds

programme.title: The House Next Door: Meet the Blacks 2

programme.title: American Psycho

programme.title: Things To Do In Denver When You're Dead

programme.title: The Dead Zone
programme.desc: A man awakens from a coma to discover he has a psychic detective ability.

programme.title: Love Jones

programme.title: Star Trek IX: Insurrection
programme.desc: When the crew of the Enterprise learns of the Federation's plot against the inhabitants of a unique planet, Capt. Picard begins an open rebellion.

programme.title: Braveheart

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programme.desc: The survivor of a space expedition claims his crew was killed by an alien creature. The rescue captain dismisses the explanation only to find that a creature has stowed away on the spacecraft and begins to hunt the human hosts.

programme.title: Day The World Ended
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world after an atomic war, seven disparate people find themselves in a protected valley in the home of a survivalist and his beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Beast With A Million Eyes
programme.desc: An unspeakable horror! Extraterrestrial terror is on the hunt for human flesh in this horrifying tale of invasion! This is a 1950s creature-feature with some serious sociological bite! Paul Birch, Lorna Thayer, and Richard Sargent star!

programme.title: Machete Kills
programme.desc: The machete-wielding federale returns in this sequel, which pits him against a maniacal arms dealer and a revolutionary in a violent battle.

programme.title: Quarantine 2: Terminal
programme.desc: Earlier tonight, a bizarre disease was unleashed in a run-down Los Angeles tenement... and no one got out alive. Yet something escaped. Now, aboard Flight 318, the first symptoms begin to show. Rating: R

programme.title: The Nutty Professor II: The Klumps
programme.desc: Eddie Murphy and America's funniest family are back for seconds in the comedy sequel about what happens when Sherman Klump's nutty alter ego, Buddy Love, starts throwing his weight around!

programme.title: Norbit
programme.desc: Murphy stars as mild-mannered Norbit, who gets a second chance at love with his childhood sweetheart, Kate. However, obstacles may make this romance slightly more difficult than expected.

programme.title: Reckless
programme.desc: A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

programme.title: Furie
programme.desc: When a little girl is kidnapped by a trafficking ring, they soon find they messed with the wrong child. Her mother, a notorious former gang leader, is close on their trail and will go to any lengths to bring her daughter home.

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
programme.desc: Burned out on dating and ready to quit, Leah takes her eccentric grandma's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights for a full year of paid rent.

programme.title: Valley Girl (2020)
programme.desc: In this musical adaptation of the hit 1983 film that changed American teenage life forever, Julie (Jessica Rothe) is the ultimate ‘80s Valley Girl, whose world is rocked when she falls hard for Randy (Josh Whitehouse), a punk rocker from Hollywood!

programme.title: I, Frankenstein
programme.desc: Frankenstein's monster becomes involved in a war between two immortal clans.

programme.title: Joy Ride
programme.desc: When a psychotic trucker takes offense at the pranks pulled by a couple of college students, the young kids are sucked into a whirlpool of terror.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: The Last Victim
programme.desc: A Neo-Western thriller set in the American Southwest, following Sheriff Hickey as he tries to solve the worst case he has seen in his small town, likely committed by a violent local gang led by a fearsome criminal.

programme.title: Forsaken (2014)
programme.desc: In 1872, an embittered gunslinger named John Henry Clayton attempts to make amends with his estranged father, Reverend Samuel Clayton, while their community is besieged by ruthless land-grabbers.

programme.title: The Monster Squad
programme.desc: Young kids form a club that is devoted to monsters, but soon get more than they bargained for when Dracula adjourns to Earth, with Frankenstein's Monster, the Wolfman, the Mummy, and the Gillman.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Sleepwalker
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: Haunted by terrifying visions, Sarah's sleepwalking episodes begin to intensify, accelerating her descent into darkness.

programme.title: Scream (2022)
programme.desc: DOUBLE FEATURE FRIDAY: Twenty-five years after a streak of brutal murders shocked the quiet town of Woodsboro, a terrifying new killer resurrects the Ghostface mask.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: Winnie-the-Pooh: Blood and Honey
programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part VI: Jason Lives
programme.desc: As a child, Tommy Jarvis did what many others died trying to do. He killed Jason Vorhees, the mass murderer who terrorized the residents of Crystal Lake. But now, years later, Tommy is tormented by the fear that maybe Jason isn’t really dead.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part VII: The New Blood
programme.desc: Ever since homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees got trapped in chains at the bottom of Crystal Lake, the nearby summer camp has operated without a hitch... without a murder. But one of this season’s happy campers has brought along a deadly secret.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Jim Bennett (Mark Wahlberg) is a professor leading a double life as a high-stakes gambler. When he borrows money from dangerous gangsters, he places the lives of his loved ones in mortal danger and must risk everything to keep from losing it all.

programme.title: Righteous Kill
programme.desc: Two veteran New York City detectives (Academy-Award-winners Robert De Niro and Al Pacino) hunt a vigilante who may be one of their own.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of H.G.Wells' classic, the sci-fi thriller reveals the extraordinary battle for the future of humankind through the eyes of one American family.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: Five young New Yorkers face a life-or-death struggle to escape from the city when a monster the size of a skyscraper suddenly appears.

programme.title: Flatliners
programme.desc: Are you afraid to die? Kiefer Sutherland isn't. He's an ambitious, charismatic medical student who persuades his classmates, Julia Roberts and Kevin Bacon, to take part in a reckless experiment. Rated: R

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature. Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

programme.title: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: Cheech and Chong make their film debut in this riotous rock'n'roll comedy, bringing with them the same madness, lifestyles and sketches that sold over 10 million records in the early 1970s.

programme.title: Monty Python and the Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur, along with his squire and his Knights of the Round Table.

programme.title: The Crow
programme.desc: Visually stunning and action-packed, this hit movie, based on the comic book series, follows the return from the grave of a young rock guitarist who, along with his fiancée, is brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals.

programme.title: The Crow: City of Angels
programme.desc: This fast-moving, action-packed sequel to THE CROW follows the rise of murder victim Ashe Corven, brought back to life by a mysterious crow. With the help of a woman named Sarah, he exacts revenge on his killers one by one.

programme.title: X: The Man With The X-Ray Eyes
programme.desc: Ray Milland stars as a brilliant scientist who tests a formula for x-ray vision on himself and discovers that his ability to see through walls, clothing, and flesh is eclipsed by an insatiable desire to see more than any mortal can possibly bear!

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam, and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death.”

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Brown Sugar
programme.desc: Two best friends finally realize that they may be in love with each other.

programme.title: Jimi: All Is By My Side
programme.desc: A drama based on Jimi Hendrix's life as he left New York City for London, where his career took off.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2
programme.desc: When his cover gets blown, a Hong Kong cop (Wu Jing) lands in a Thai prison where the warden works with a criminal mastermind (Louis Koo) to harvest organs.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi (Donnie Yen) is a village craftsman whose quiet life is irrevocably shattered by the arrival of two notorious gangsters in the local general store.

programme.title: Scary Movie 3
programme.desc: David Zucker (AIRPLANE!) directs SCARY MOVIE 3, which piles on hysterical yet gratuitous cameos from thrillers, blockbusters, and pop culture in general, getting its best goosing yet.

programme.title: Scary Movie 4
programme.desc: The all-star cast returns to pull serious spoofs of The Grudge, Saw, War of the Worlds, and The Village. While her house is haunted by a little boy, Cindy is determined to find out who killed him and why.

programme.title: Scary Movie 5
programme.desc: Home with their newly-formed family, happy parents Dan and Jody are haunted by sinister, paranormal activities — disrupting new mama Jody’s dancing aspirations in the “Swan Lake” ballet and threatening Dan’s rise as an ape researcher.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Ghost
programme.desc: Patrick Swayze plays a ghost who teams with a psychic (Whoopi Goldberg) to uncover the truth behind his murder — and to rescue his sweetheart (Demi Moore) from a similar fate.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: Rescue Dawn
programme.desc: In 1965, while bombing Laos, pilot Dieter Dengler crashes in the jungle. Dieter is arrested, tortured and sent to a prison camp, where he organizes an escape plan. A betrayal splits the group and Dieter finds that the jungle is the actual prison.

programme.title: A Home of Our Own
programme.desc: A single mother leaves Los Angeles with her six children and moves to Idaho. She buys a broken-down house without a roof, doors or windows. Weathering natural disasters and personal conflict, they rebuild the house and their lives.

programme.title: Wild Horses

programme.title: The Fall Of The House Of Usher (1960)

programme.title: We Were Soldiers

programme.title: Scream 2

programme.title: Widows

programme.title: Ip Man

programme.title: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
programme.desc: When a zombie invasion ravages their peaceful town, three scouts and one badass cocktail waitress will fight for the badge of a lifetime and put their scouting skills to the test to save humanity from the undead.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: An unlikely romance between a beautiful human teen and a sensitive undead slacker sets off a chain of events with the power to transform the world.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: Michelle Pfeiffer plays Frankie, a waitress at a N.Y.C. coffee shop. After a series of hurtful relationships, the last thing Frankie’s looking for is a new man...until he comes looking for her.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Theatrical Cut)
programme.desc: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: Indecent Proposal
programme.desc: Demi Moore and Woody Harrelson are Diana and David Murphy, a financially strapped couple who are betting on a quick trip to Las Vegas to deal them a lucky hand. But the odds are suddenly even more attractive when billionaire John Gage ups the ante.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: Forsaken (2014)
programme.desc: In 1872, an embittered gunslinger named John Henry Clayton attempts to make amends with his estranged father, Reverend Samuel Clayton, while their community is besieged by ruthless land-grabbers.

programme.title: Wild Horses
programme.desc: A detective opens up a fifteen-year-old missing persons case and begins to suspect that the boy it belongs to was murdered - and that a local rancher was involved.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Join The Addams Family for the most hilarious scarefest of this season or any other! When long-lost Uncle Fester reappears after twenty-five years in the Bermuda Triangle, Gomez and Morticia plan a celebration to wake the dead.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: The family’s future grows bleak when the no-good nanny marries Fester and has the kids shipped off to summer camp. But Wednesday still has a Thing or two up her sleeve.

programme.title: A Quiet Place Part II
programme.desc: Following the deadly events at home, the Abbott family (Emily Blunt, Millicent Simmonds, Noah Jupe) continues their fight for survival in silence, now facing the terrors of the outside world in this suspenseful thriller directed by John Krasinski.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a bizarre, traumatic patient incident, Dr. Rose Cotter (Sosie Bacon) starts experiencing terrifying visions. As the lines between reality and nightmares blur, Rose must confront her troubling past to escape her chilling new reality.

programme.title: The Possession of Hannah Grace
programme.desc: Following a failed exorcism, Megan Reed (Shay Mitchell) is working overnight at the morgue when she takes delivery of a disfigured cadaver. Soon, Megan begins to experience horrifying visions and starts to suspect that a demon may possess her body.

programme.title: Jennifer's Body
programme.desc: A possessed cheerleader gains an appetite for her male classmates.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part V: A New Beginning
programme.desc: This time, he seems to have set his sights on the young patients at a secluded halfway house. And more than a few of his teen targets end up in half, in quarters... You name it, Jason does it.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Attack the Block

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: The West Texas desert has a way of pulling you in. In Desert Ghost, Will Cooper heads west to Marathon, Texas, with longtime friend and mentor Cody Roberts to hunt aoudad in one of the most remote landscapes in the state. Rooted in family legacy, this film explores Cody's deep ties to the desert, the story behind Desert Ghost Distillery, and the mystique of a western oasis near Big Bend National Park. More than a hunt, Desert Ghost dives into the role of aoudad management and its importance to desert bighorn sheep conservation efforts led by Texas Parks and Wildlife and the Wild Sheep Foundation. Sometimes, to protect what belongs here — you have to chase the ghosts. You really do have to be tough, determined, or one lucky bastard to make it out in West Texas.

That's just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Costaki Economopoulos
programme.desc: For 20 years Costaki has been living his dream as a full-time stand up comic. He has written jokes for Bette Midler, Jay Leno, MTV, and BET. You may have seen him on Showtime or heard him on Sirius, but you probably know him best from his regular appearances on the nationally syndicated Bob & Tom Radio Show.

programme.title: Michael Joiner
programme.desc: Michaelís brand of comedy is, in a word, familiar. Not in the sense that youíve heard it before, but more so that he knows you and you know him. He speaks about the things you are thinking in a way that sounds so much like your inner voice it is astounding. His effortless delivery will resonate with you. Michael is the 1st Place winner of the Hollywood Improv's "FUNNIEST COMIC IN L.A." 2008, and 2010 Christian Music Hall of Fame "COMEDIAN OF THE YEAR" nominee, Joiner has attracted wide praise for his routines that blend a sarcastic edginess with a devotion to clean humor. Joiner has headlined at The LA AREA Improvs, The Funny Bone, The Ice House and other comedy clubs across the country while also performing at colleges and sold out Clean Comedy Concerts nationwide. He's also written for "The Tonight Show With Jay Leno." He has been performing nationwide for over 25 years and is rated one of the nation's funniest Clean Stand-up Comedians. The TV Guide Network calls Michael "One of the funniest, most original, stand up Comedians working today!" In 2006, Michael was one out of only four Comedians chosen worldwide to star in the top selling DVD, "The Clean Stand Up Comedy Tour." programme.title: Oscar Peterson
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson's virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964. Let the sublime artistry of Art Tatum captivate you as he interprets Antonín Dvořák's “Humoresque” in 1953. Discover Thelonious Monk's enigmatic genius as his quartet performs his iconic composition “Round About Midnight” in Poland on April 4, 1966. Experience the timeless appeal of the Dave Brubeck Quartet's odd-metered “Take Five", recorded live in Brussels, Belgium, on October 10, 1964. Delight in the lyrical beauty of Bud Powell's solo performance of “Sweet and Lovely” at the Antibes Jazz Festival of July 13, 1960. Witness the fusion of jazz and funk in Herbie Hancock & The Headhunters' exhilarating studio performance of “Sly” in Bremen, Germany, recorded on November 6, 1974. Lastly, enjoy the soulful grooves of Horace Silver's “Song for my Father” performed by his quintet at the Umbria Jazz Festival of July 20, 1976. Tune in and let these legendary jazz pianists transport you on unforgettable musical adventures!

programme.title: Bootsy Collins
programme.sub-title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World'. With this album, Bootsy Collins pays tribute to the artists with whom he worked during his frantic career: from James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic to Fatboy Slim. During this concert, recorded at the festival Jazz à Vienne, Bootsy maintains that same energy, giving a spectacular show.

programme.title: Milt Jackson, John Lewis, Percy Heath & Connie Kay
programme.sub-title: Milt Jacksons' Modern Jazz Quartet at the Bozar
programme.desc: The Modern Jazz Quartet (MJQ) was composed of Milt 'Bags' Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums. Milt Jackson and John Lewis were pioneer bebop musicians who had played together in Dizzy Gillespie's 1948 big band. They pursued separate careers before adding Heath and Lewis to form the Modern Jazz Quartet in the 1950s. Noted for its delicate percussion sonorities, innovative jazz forms, and high performance standards, the MJQ was an immensely popular jazz and “third stream” ensemble until its final concerts in the early 1990s.

programme.title: Buck Clayton, Henry Chaix, Théo Siegrist & Pierre Bouru
programme.desc: In the second half of June 1965, during a prolonged European concert tour, American trumpeter Buck Clayton (1911–1991) played a residency at the Chikito, a club in Bern, Switzerland. With a local rhythm section of French pianist Henry Chaix, Swiss double bassist Théo Siegrist, and Swiss drummer Pierre Bouru, this stalwart of the Count Basie Orchestra gave a sparkling performance that was documented for posterity by Radio Télévision Suisse in the program ‘Variétés'. Opening with the George Gershwin favorite ‘'S Wonderful', the program continues with two swing-era classics: ‘I Can't Get Started' and ‘Honeysuckle Rose'. Revel at how easily Clayton finishes ‘Honeysuckle Rose' on a high concert F! A spirited romp through Juan Tizol's composition ‘Perdido' closes this recording. The success of this booking ensured Clayton received repeated warm receptions in Bern in the following decades.

programme.title: Miles Davis
programme.desc: American trumpeter Miles Davis (1926-1991) was a pioneering jazz musician from the late 1940s to the late 1980s. His influence on 20th century music is hard to overstate, as he trailblazed bebop, cool jazz, hardbop, modal jazz, and electronic music. On October 11, 1964, Miles Davis performed at Teatro Dell'Arte in Milan. With tenor saxophonist Wayne Shorter, pianist Herbie Hancock, bassist Ron Carter and drummer Tony Williams, Davis performed Autumn Leaves, My Funny Valentine, All Blues, All of You, and Joshua.

programme.title: Wes Montgomery
programme.sub-title: Herbie Man & Sonny Sharrock - Memphis underground
programme.desc: This selection of unforgettable performances by some of the most iconic and influential jazz guitarists in history showcases these legends' unique essence. Revel in Wes Montgomery's virtuosity as he performs the captivating “Nica's Dream” in Holland in 1965, and delight in the expressive beauty of his rendition of “Here's That Rainy Day”, recorded in London in that same year. Experience the timeless appeal of Joe Pass's “You Stepped Out of a Dream” and “You Turned The Tables on Me”, recorded live in Hanover in 1975. The interplay between Jim Hall and Atilla Zoller borders on the impossible as they perform “Extensions” in Hanover in 1973. Enjoy Jim Hall's lyrical solo performance of “I'm Getting Sentimental Over You” from 1964. Witness Sonny Sharrock's avant-garde fusion of jazz and rock in an exhilarating performance of “Peanut", recorded live in France in 1970. Sharrock is joined by flutist Herbie Mann in a soulful performance of “Memphis Underground” from 1969. Immerse yourself in the magic of jazz guitar!

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Wayne Shorter
programme.sub-title: Wayne Shorter Quintet - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In July 1996, renowned American saxophonist Wayne Shorter and his quintet performed at Estival Jazz Lugano. Together with pianist Jim Beard, guitarist David Gilmore, bassist Alphonso Johnson, and drummer Rodney van Holmes, Shorter shows he is still at his best.

programme.title: Antoine Tamistit & Robin Ticciati
programme.sub-title: Walton's Viola Concerto & Brahms's Symphony No. 4
programme.desc: British conductor Robin Ticciati conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of William Walton's Viola Concerto and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 4 in E minor, Op. 98. When the young Walton premiered his Viola Concerto in 1927, it caused a Europe-wide sensation: a composer in his twenties, taking a neglected instrument and writing for it with unprecedented imagination and power. Viola virtuoso Antoine Tamestit features as the soloist in this Concerto. Brahms's Symphony No. 4 would be the composer's last – but every note burns with creative fire. This concert, which unites youthful genius with music drawn from a profound engagement with life, was recorded at LSO St. Luke's on Old Street in London, UK, on October 14, 2021.

programme.title: Roberto Abbado, Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma & Eleonora Buratto
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem, recorded at the Parco Ducale di Parma, Italy as part of Festival Verdi 2020. The soloists are soprano Eleonora Buratto, mezzosoprano Anita Rachvelishvili, tenor Giorgio Berrugi, and bass Roberto Tagliavini. When his fellow composer Gioachino Rossini died in 1868, Verdi proposed to compose a ‘Messa per Rossini' in his honor, to be written by himself and several other Italian composers. Verdi wrote the concluding movement, ‘Libera me'. When the premiere was cancelled, the project lay dormant. When Italian poet Alessandro Manzoni passed away a few years later, Verdi revisited his plan to compose a requiem – this time in honor of the poet he so greatly admired. As an opera composer, Verdi knew better than anyone how to infuse the work with drama, as is evident in the revised version of his ‘Libera me'. The famous, powerful ‘Dies Irae' especially stands out, depicting the horrors of the Last Judgement.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Sir John Eliot Gardiner & Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival. As part of the festival's 2021 edition, Sir John Eliot Gardiner leads the Orchestra del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a wonderful concert program that includes Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 in C minor, Op. 17, ‘Little Russian', and Edward Elgar's Variations on an Original Theme, Op. 36, better known as the Enigma Variations. Written in 1872, Tchaikovsky's Symphony No. 2 bears the nickname ‘Little Russian', as the composer used folk tunes in his work from Ukraine, then known as ‘Little Russia'. Completed in 1899, Elgar's Enigma Variations is an orchestral work comprising a theme and fourteen variations, each variation being a musical sketch of one of the composer's friends. This performance was recorded at Teatro del Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in Florence, Italy, in 2021.

programme.title: Stephanie Childress, Alina Ibragimova & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.desc: Stephanie Childress conducts the London Symphony Orchestra and Sibelius and Mendelssohn provide the soundtrack for this unique concert with a distinctly Northern European flavor, live from London's LSO St Luke's. The evening begins with Jean Sibelius's En Saga, a symphonic poem that, like its composer, has become a defining figure of Finnish national musical identity. On the other side of the Baltic, it took Mendelssohn six years to complete his famed Violin Concerto—and it was well worth the wait, as violin virtuoso Alina Ibragimova's powerhouse rendition will demonstrate! The concert ends in style with two short works from Finland: Lumière et pesanteur by the fabulous Kaija Saariaho—ranked the world's greatest living composer by BBC Music Magazine—and another work by the endlessly inventive Sibelius, the spirited and episodic Cassazione.
